title: Klettenweg, Berlin
description:
Frei vom 19.04.-22.05.2026 für eine Person.

Herzlich willkommen in unserem 2014 erbauten 1-Zimmer-Apartment! Es befindet sich im 1. OG eines freistehenden Einfamilienhauses in einer ruhigen Gegend im Südosten von Berlin im Bezirk Rudow nahe der Humboldt Universität in Adlershof und nahe dem Flughafen BER und wir freuen uns auf einen neuen Mieter. Unsere vorletzte Mieterin hat 5 Jahre bei uns verbracht und ist aus beruflichen Gründen ausgezogen und unsere letzte Mieterin wurde leider kurzfristig beruflich versetzt. Auch sie wäre sehr gerne länger geblieben. 

Da wir in der Nebenstraße einer Nebenstraße wohnen, ist es hier sehr ruhig. Unsere nächste Bushaltestelle ist 4 Fußminuten entfernt. Von hier gelangen Sie in weiteren 7 Minuten zum U-Bahnhof Rudow. Es fahren die Busse 172 oder 372. In 10 Autominuten sind Sie am Flughafen Schönefeld, Fluglärm ist sehr selten zu hören. Die Stadtautobahn ist in 2-5 Minuten erreichbar und die Humboldt Universität in Adlershof ist mit dem Rad in 10 Minuten erreicht. Am U-Bahnhof stehen auch E-Roller und E-Bikes. Ein Rad können Sie auf Ihre Verantwortung bei uns kostenlos leihen. Ihr eigenes Rad können Sie gerne mitbringen und es findet sich dafür ein Platz.

Über einen separaten Zugang erreichen Sie Ihr ca. 44 m2 großes Domizil. Wir möchten, dass es Ihnen an nichts fehlt. So wurde diese großzügige Wohnung von uns liebevoll und überwiegend hochwertig eingerichtet vom Fön bis zum Rührgerät, Handtücher, Bettwäsche vorhanden, schnelles Internet.

Eine bodentiefe Fensterfront und zwei Oberlichter sorgen für viel Helligkeit. Die Wohnung ist ausgestattet mit Einbauküche (Geschirrspüler, Kühlschrank mit Tiefkühlfach, Elektroherd mit Backofen, Kaffeemaschine, Toaster, Teekocher, Geschirr, Töpfe usw.), Wannenbad mit Akazienvollholzmöbeln, Abstellraum, Fußbodenheizung, Elektrojalousien, Waschtrockner (erneuert), Fernseher, Standventilator. Das sehr hochwertige Schlafsofa der Marke Messina mit enthaltener separater Matratze sorgt für Ihren erholsamen Schlaf (wurde 2023 erneuert). In den beiden Max Winzer Sesseln (wurden 2019 erneuert) lässt sich der Blick in den Himmel genießen oder Sie beobachten die Vögel, Katzen und Eichhörnchen in Garten und Bäumen. In den großen Kleiderschrank passen Ihre Sachen, Palisandertischchen und Esstisch geben der Wohnung eine gemütliche Atmosphäre. Aus der Filmbibliothek können Sie sich gerne Filme ausleihen. Den Garten dürfen Sie gerne mitbenutzen. Ein Stellplatz für Ihr Auto steht Ihnen auf dem Grundstück zur Verfügung. Aufgrund des Interesses meines Sohnes haben wir sehr schnelles Internet.

Im angegebenen Mietpreis pro Monat sind alle Betriebskosten außer Strom enthalten.

Endreinigung 60 € einmalig
Strom 50 €/Monat - Abrechnung nach Zähler

title: Zinsgutstraße, Berlin
description:
DE:
Das Apartment in der Zinsgutstr. in Berlin Adlershof besteht aus drei getrennten Zimmern, die sich auch gut als WG eignen. In den zwei großen Zimmern können jeweils zwei Personen schlafen und in dem kleinen Zimmer noch eine Person, so dass bis zu 5 Personen in der Wohnung Platz finden. Darüber hinaus gibt es eine große Wohnküche und ein Badezimmer mit Fenster und Badewanne. Ein Balkon ist ebenfalls vorhanden.
Adlershof stellt eine "Stadt für Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft, Medien und Wirtschaft" dar und befindet sich nahe der Stadtautobahn und des Flughafens Schönefeld.
Alle wichtigen infrastrukturellen Einrichtungen, wie Buse, Tram, S-Bahn, Schulen, Kitas, Supermärkte, ect. befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe.
Das Apartment eignet sich bei längeren Aufenthalten für 4 Personen. Bei kürzeren Aufenthalten sind auch 5 Personen möglich.

EN:
The apartment in the Zinsgutstr. in Berlin Adlershof consists of three separate rooms, which are also well suited as shared flats. In the two large rooms two persons can sleep in each room and in the small room one more person, so that up to 5 persons can sleep in the apartment. In addition, there is a large kitchen-living room and a bathroom with window and bathtub. A balcony is also available.
The pictures show the furnishing of the previous tenants. 
Adlershof represents a "city for science, economy, media and business" and is located near the city highway and the airport Schönefeld.
All important infrastructural facilities, such as bus, tram, S-Bahn, schools, day-care centres, supermarkets, etc. are in the immediate vicinity. 
The apartment is designed for 4 persons for long term stays. For shorter stays 5 persons are also possible.

title: Treskowallee, Berlin
description:
Serviced Apartment - A piece of home for a few months? 

Whether you are traveling for work, traveling or just need a nice place to stay for a long time:In our fully and smartly furnished apartments you get high-quality furnishings and individual service. 
The up to 25m2 large modern studios are equipped with a kitchenette, two separate bed with a bed width of 0.90m and a flat screen TV. 
The modern kitchenette is fully equipped: fridge, dishwasher, 2 hobs, microwave and extractor hood: everything is there! So that you can serve yourself something delicious at any time, dishes, glasses, bowls, pots and cooking utensils are included. There is also a table with seating. The rooms are cleaned every week by our staff. 

Laundry Room: Washing machine (fee required), Dryer (fee required)

----
*Uncomplicated CheckIn on the day of arrival*.

1 week before arrival you will receive an email with further information for the day of arrival as well as instructions for using the app and the checkin kiosk.

1)	Do you already use the free app "Hotelbird" for PreCheckIn and room card? 

With the app, you can check in on the day of arrival while on the move. Enter the booking number and last name of the booking and follow the instructions in the app. 

Through the app, you use your phone as a key and can no longer lose it.

For the use of the app you need to activate the Bluetooth function!!

2)	You want to check in on site first?

Our checkin-kiosk is also available around the clock.
Have your booking number and last name of the booking ready and follow the instructions on the screen.

++Please note that you can only create your room card via app or checkin-kiosk after 2 pm.++

We are available for you by phone around the clock. If you would like to speak to a member of staff on site, please refer to the notices at the reception desk in the building.


In the event of non-business stays in the city of Berlin, a visitor's tax of 5% of the net overnight stay will be charged additionally, limited to a contiguous overnight stay of 21 days. 

----
Neighborhood:
The apartment is located in the district Berlin Karlshorst and only 100m from the Karlshorst S-Bahn station. 
The location of your accommodation offers everything your heart desires. In Karlshorst, living in the countryside, work and leisure meet. In idyllic Karlshorst, a district of Berlin-Lichtenberg, you can relax after a long day of work with a trip to the harness racing track or the beautiful beach on the Müggelsee or enjoy the city life after a short drive in the center of Berlin. Cultural interests, recreation from everyday life and an exciting nightlife can be wonderfully combined here.

title: Zwieseler Straße, Berlin
description:
A bright (East and West exposition with big windows) fully furnished family townhouse on two floors. It was built and renovated in 2013 in the historic area of Museum Karlshorst. Friendly and international family neighbors.

Great access to public transport and grocery shopping nearby. Zwieseler Straße is located between S-Bahnhof Karlshorst und dem U-Bahnhof Tierpark. In 15 minutes with S-und U-Bahn to the city centre, bus and tram stops nearby as well. 2 big playgrounds and a child friendly environment.

What's around:

-Excellent and safe location for families, two big playgrounds and nature reserve Biesenhorster Sand in walking distance. Wuhleide Park

-The recreation and amusement park of Wuhlheide is just 5 minutes away by car or 10 minutes by bicycle

- Tierpark, the largest zoo in Europe, is also minutes away


Reason for rental offer: year abroad until summer July 2027.

This rental is only open for families. We kindly request that you tell us how many people wish to stay in the house and a bit about yourself. Thank you and we are looking forward to meeting you!

title: Alfelder Straße, Berlin
description:
Es ist 1 Zimmer in einem schönem Einfamilienhaus in grüner Umgebung, Biesdorf-Süd, U-Bahn, Bus, S-Bahn in der Nähe, 23min bis zum Hauptbahnhof mit der U-Bahn 


Die Größe der Zimmer findest du auf dem Grundriss-Bild und die Deckenhöhe beträgt 2,30m.

Das Zimmer ist voll möbliert - siehe Bilder.

Bad:
Das Bad, mit Dusche, Waschmaschine und Trockner, hast du zur Verfügung und ist ebenfalls nach Norden ausgerichtet.

Besonderheiten im Bad : Die Raumhöhe beträgt 1,80m und es gibt keine separate Abtrennung der Dusche von der Toilette.

Küche:
Die Küche wird von allen benutzt und ist voll ausgestattet; bedeutet auch, dass du alles in der Küche nutzen kannst.
Die Küche ist eine geräumige Wohnküche und bietet mehrere Sitzplätze..

Garten:
Um das Haus herum befindet sich ein großer begrünter Garten mit Außensitzfläche und einem Gartenhäuschen, um darin zu sitzen.
Ebenso gibt es einige Nutzbäume und Pflanzen, die gern mitgenutzt/-geertnet werden dürfen.
Z.B. Kirsch- und Apfelbäume.

Allgemein:
Kein WLAN vorhanden .

Die Miete umfasst alle Nebenkosten: Wohnmiete, Versicherungen, Strom/Wasser.
Haustiere sind nicht erwünscht.
Nichtraucherhaushalt - auch nicht draußen.
Die Vermietung ist nicht an Personen mit Kindern gerichtet.
Die Reinigung  betrifft nicht den Wohnbeich, dieser  liegt in Eigenverantwortung. 
Haftpflichtversicherung  erforderlich,  kann vor Ort  abgeschlossen werden. 
Anmeldung möglich. 


Bitte die Nachweise bei der Bewerbung mitsenden.


Aufenthaltsgenehmigung,  Ausweis, Arbeitsvertrag/Studienzulassung,

title: Bruno-Bürgel-Weg, Berlin
description:
*german description below* 

Hello,

I am offering a furnished flat in Berlin-Schöneweide for temporary subletting for residential purposes. The cat on the pictures has moved out and does not live here anymore. 

The apartment is my primary residence. Due to a temporary private absence, I am renting out the flat on a one-time, temporary basis for the period between May and the end of August.

The sublease is exclusively for a reliable individual or a stable couple who will be living in Berlin for several months (e.g., internship, studies, or project).

This is expressly not a vacation, holiday, or short-term offer and is not intended for tourist purposes.

The bedroom is approx. 18 m2 and fully furnished (bed, desk, wardrobe). In addition, there is shared storage space in the hallway and shared use of the common areas. The second room can be used as a hobby room or office.

Living room: approx. 22 m2 with access to the terrace and garden.
Kitchen: approx. 12 m2, fully equipped (including dishwasher and washing machine).
Bathroom: approx. 6 m2 with window.

Internet, utilities, and electricity are included in the rent.
The sublease is not for profit; the costs consist of basic rent, utilities, broadcasting license fee, internet, and electricity and can be broken down transparently.

The apartment is located in the immediate vicinity of the Oberspree S-Bahn station (approx. 2 minutes' walk). Shopping facilities such as REWE and dm are within walking distance.

Pets (especially cats) are allowed by arrangement. There is an approx. 40 sqm cat enclosure with direct access to the kitchen window. 

------

Hallo,

ich biete eine möblierte Wohnung in Berlin-Schöneweide zur befristeten Untervermietung zu Wohnzwecken an. Die Katze auf den Bildern ist ausgezogen und lebt nicht mehr hier. 

Die Wohnung ist mein Hauptwohnsitz. Aufgrund einer vorübergehenden privaten Abwesenheit vermiete ich die Wohnung einmalig und befristet für den Zeitraum zwischen Mai bis Ende August.

Die Untervermietung richtet sich ausschließlich an eine zuverlässige Einzelperson oder ein festes Paar, die für mehrere Monate in Berlin leben (z. B. Praktikum, Studium oder Projekt).

Dies ist ausdrücklich kein Urlaubs-, Ferien- oder Kurzzeitangebot und nicht für touristische Zwecke bestimmt.

Das Schlafzimmer ist ca. 18 m2 groß und vollständig möbliert (Bett, Schreibtisch, Kleiderschrank). Zusätzlich stehen anteilig Stauraum im Flur sowie die Mitbenutzung der Gemeinschaftsräume zur Verfügung. Das zweite Zimmer kann also Hobby- oder Büroraum genutzt werden.

Wohnzimmer: ca. 22 m2 mit Zugang zur Terrasse und zum Garten
Küche: ca. 12 m2, voll ausgestattet (inkl. Spülmaschine und Waschmaschine)
Bad: ca. 6 m2 mit Fenster

Internet, Nebenkosten und Strom sind in der Miete enthalten.
Die Untervermietung erfolgt ohne Gewinnerzielungsabsicht; die Kosten setzen sich aus Grundmiete, Nebenkosten, Rundfunkbeitrag, Internet und Strom zusammen und können transparent aufgeschlüsselt werden.

Die Wohnung liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe des S‐Bahnhof Oberspree (ca. 2 Minuten Fußweg). Einkaufsmöglichkeiten wie REWE und dm sind fußläufig erreichbar.

Haustiere (insbesondere Katzen) sind nach Absprache möglich. Ein ca. 40qm großes Katzengehege ist mit direktem Zugang zum Küchenfenster vorhanden.

title: Ontarioseestraße, Berlin
description:
Fully furnished student apartments. 
Our Bronze apartments are fully furnished and perfect for student life. You’ll have a comfy bed, your own private kitchen, an en-suite bathroom, and a dedicated study space with a desk and chair. There’s also a big wardrobe and plenty of storage for all your stuff. Plus, high-speed WiFi and all-inclusive rent mean no surprise bills—just move in and make yourself at home. 
You will also have access to shared spaces like the gym, lounge, study rooms and communal kitchen: all included in your rent. Tierpark is conveniently located – just a 2-minute walk from the U-Bahn, tram and bus stops, close to shops, and just around the corner from the University of Applied Sciences (HTW). Any questions? No problem! Our friendly multilingual operational team at the front desk is always happy to help.

title: Freystadter Weg, Berlin
description:
This modern, fully furnished two-story house offers approx. 130 sqm of comfortable living space in a quiet and well-connected residential area. It features 4 rooms in total, including 2 bedrooms, a spacious living room, and an additional small room that can be used as a home office or guest room. The property also includes 2 bathrooms—one with a bathtub and shower, plus an additional guest bathroom with a shower.

The bright open-plan kitchen is fully equipped and connects seamlessly to the living and dining area, creating a spacious and practical layout. A private terrace provides additional outdoor space for relaxing or entertaining.

Please note that there are currently no beds in the house; however, beds can be provided upon request.

Located in a quiet and modern residential area in Berlin-Adlershof, the property offers a pleasant balance between calm living and excellent city connectivity. The neighborhood is known for its clean, well-maintained surroundings and a mix of residential homes and innovation hubs. Daily essentials such as supermarkets, cafés, and local services are within easy reach, while green spaces nearby provide opportunities for walking and outdoor relaxation. The area is well connected by public transport, offering quick access to central Berlin as well as surrounding districts, making it ideal for professionals, families, and longer stays. Parking may be available upon request for an additional fee.

title: Büchnerweg, Berlin
description:
Life at Berlin Adlershof
295 apartments, 295+ students... be one of us & meet extraordinary people. Adlershof is not only a home to renowned non-university research institutions, six institutes of the Humboldt University and around 1,200 companies that are perfect for internships, but also – and this is the best part – our brand new building. Be a part of our community and meet exciting people like you. Our student residence is just a stone’s throw away from the Humboldt University of Berlin – Campus Adlershof. And you’ll find everything else you need for a laid-back student life in the surrounding area as well – from various shopping stores to McDonalds, McFit and Obi, everything is within walking distance.

Our student community offers stylishly designed apartments for those who thrive on the energy of big cities. With us, you have a fully-furnished home complete with high speed wifi, gym, gaming areas, multimedia gaming room, 24-hour laundry, study areas and a very spacious community lobby. There’s also solid access to a diverse network of friends, events, and other amazing opportunities.

Are you looking for a stylish new home base with the perfect combination of hip lifestyle and clear design? This apartment category offers you a personal living experience in a 17sqm space miracle. Our bed with feel-good factor, your own workspace, an additional dining area, sufficient storage throughout the room, a stylish kitchenette with microwave, induction hob, fridge and a modern shower room turn your apartment into an adorable home. 

*Prices may vary depending on floor level, length of stay and rental period.

Included in your All-in rent: 
- Utilities (water, heating, electricity)
- fully furnished Apartment 
- high speed internet up to 1 Gbit/s 
- Community Areas, such as
   - Lobby with on-site staff
   - Laundrette
   - Study areas & Silent room
   - Gaming Areas with Kicker, Billiard, AirHockey, Ping-Pong
   - Gaming room with gaming console
   - Outdoor Areas with Roof Top Terrace
   - Community Kitchen
   - Gym (160sqm)

As well as:
- Bicycle Storage 
- Front Office 
- Cashless-Payment Systems 
- Events 
- CCTV in the whole building for your Security 
- Security Service on Call in the night 

For each contract a security deposit of 1,5 all in rent applies as well as a one-time handling fee of 235 EUR.

Take a relaxed approach to deposit security. We have partnered with Garentii to offer a quick and comfortable solution. For a small fee, you can skip the deposit and save on upfront costs. Ready to say goodbye to deposits? 
IMPORTANT: To complete your booking, you must transfer the deposit or enroll with Garentii deposit insurance. Failing to do so, your application will not be processed.

You want to book directly your preferred apartment or take a look at our other apartment categories? 
Our booking process is fully digital and as comfortable as a hotel booking. 

This is a group advertisement. The photos represent more than one flat and are sample pictures.

-----------------------------------------------

What happens after your booking is completed on HousingAnywhere?

Good to know: After your booking has been confirmed on HousingAnywhere, you have to finalize your reservation in our system. The following steps have to be completed:
1. You will receive a link to our website by e-mail.
2. On our website, you have to select the apartment type you have booked on HousingAnywhere.
3. As the next step, you will receive password-protected access to our app where you can upload your enrollment certificate, as well as a copy of your ID card or passport, and confirm the contract.
4. Afterward, we will check your details, and if everything fits you will receive an automatic e-mail with the payment request of the deposit and our one-off handling fee (this payment differs from the HousingAnywhere booking fee!).
5. As soon as there are no more pending payments (within the next 5 business days) and we have received the money, we will finalize the booking and you will receive a final confirmation e-mail.
6. Please note that the booking through our system should be completed no later than 7 days after booking on HousingAnywhere. After 7 days, the room is no longer reserved for you and can be booked by others. Just before the semester starts, reservations can only be held for 2 days. In this case, a refund of the costs paid so far is not guaranteed.

-----------------------------------------------

What lease terms are available and what is the deal with the 1 week early move out?

Depending on the property, you can choose between apartments with a minimum lease term of 6 to 12 months. However, during this rental period you must always be studying. Please note, the return of your apartment to us is one week before the end of the rental period, in order to be able to carry out cleaning, maintenance and repair measures necessary due to the use of the apartment and for a direct follow-up rental. We have calculated the rent on the basis of an effective term shortened by one week, so that this regulation does not represent an economic disadvantage for you. Of course, if you extend your stay with us and continue to reside in your apartment, no prior move-out is required between your old lease and your new lease.

title: Wendenschloßstraße, Berlin
description:
HOUSE
The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a beautiful house build in 1997. There is an elevator in the building.

APARTMENT
Step into this beautiful apartment through a spacious and welcoming hallway that immediately creates a sense of comfort and style. The bright living room features a cozy sofa, a large smart TV, and a dining table for four, perfect for relaxing evenings or entertaining guests. The master bedroom offers a comfortable king-size bed (180×200) for restful nights. The second bedroom includes a single bed and a desk, making it ideal as a guest room or a quiet home office. The fully equipped kitchen provides everything you need, including cookware, cutlery, a large refrigerator, oven and stove, dishwasher, kettle, and coffee machine, perfect for everyday living. The bathroom includes a bathtub for relaxing after a long day, as well as a washing machine for your convenience. The true highlight of the apartment is the exceptionally large balcony, offering stunning views and plenty of space to unwind and enjoy the outdoors.

AREA
The apartment is located in the peaceful and green district of Treptow-Köpenick, offering a relaxed residential atmosphere while staying well connected to Berlin. Shopping is very convenient, with supermarkets, bakeries, and other essentials just a short walk away. The area is close to lakes and the River Spree, perfect for walks, cycling, or simply enjoying the outdoors. The historic old town of Köpenick, with its cafés, restaurants, and bars, is also nearby. Public transport is reliable, making it easy to reach the city center and beyond. The neighborhood is safe, family-friendly, and popular with professionals and expats seeking a quiet yet convenient lifestyle.

Move here to be near: Treptower Park, old town Köpenick, Köpenick Palace, Müggelsee, Molecule Man, and Stadion An der Alten Försterei (the home to FC Union Berlin)

Overview
Treptow-Köpenick is Berlin's largest and least densely populated district. The beautiful forests, lakes, and affordable cost of living make this area popular with families and native East Germans. It is ideal for anyone looking for something more tranquil and picturesque, but still well-connected to downtown.

What can I do here?
When you aren't exploring the lakes and forests, catch an FC Union Berlin game, or visit the more than 140 shops at The Forum shopping center on Bahnhofstrasse. For a night out, see a show at Stadttheater Cöpenick, an old German theater that opened in 1889. Gasthaus Zenner offers old-school German cuisine, and Freiheit 15 is a cool riverside event space with a restaurant and beer garden.

Fascinating fact
Three-(hidden) of Treptow-Köpenick is either water, woods, or parks, and it is often called the "green lungs of Berlin".

Cozy room in 4-bedroom apartment in Adlershof

Room Description
Bedroom 1 is a sunny room furnished with a single bed, desk, and a standalone wardrobe.

Description
Extra documentation, special conditions and variable rent prices apply. Please read the landlord policies carefully.

There are rooms for rent in this 66 m2 4-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment on Neltestraße in Treptow-Köpenick. The kitchen comes with an oven and microwave, while the bathroom has a shower over bath.

There are plenty of green spaces nearby for the nature lover, including Neue Wiesen and for the sports fan, there is a tennis club and rowing club nearby.

Neighborhood information
Treptow-Köpenick
In one word: Green
Closest Metro: Treptower Park (S8, S9, S41, S42, S85), Köpenick (S3), Plänterwald (S8, S9, S45, S46, S85), Schöneweide (S8, S9, S42, S45-47, S85, RB, RB24), and Adlershof (S8, S9, S45, S46, S85)
Move here to be near: Treptower Park, old town Köpenick, Köpenick Palace, Müggelsee, Molecule Man, and Stadion An der Alten Försterei (the home to FC Union Berlin)

Overview
Treptow-Köpenick is Berlin's largest and least densely populated district. The beautiful forests, lakes, and affordable cost of living make this area popular with families and native East Germans. It is ideal for anyone looking for something more tranquil and picturesque, but still well-connected to downtown.

What can I do here?
When you aren't exploring the lakes and forests, catch an FC Union Berlin game, or visit the more than 140 shops at The Forum shopping center on Bahnhofstrasse. For a night out, see a show at Stadttheater Cöpenick, an old German theater that opened in 1889. Gasthaus Zenner offers old-school German cuisine, and Freiheit 15 is a cool riverside event space with a restaurant and beer garden.

Fascinating fact
Three-(hidden) of Treptow-Köpenick is either water, woods, or parks, and it is often called the "green lungs of Berlin".

title: Goethestraße, Berlin
description:
Diese gemütliche und ruhige 2-Zimmer Wohnung wirkt durch das Schaffen von unterschiedlichen Wohnbereichen viel geräumiger als man bei 51 qm denken könnte. Das Wohnzimmer und Schlafzimmer bieten alles, was man braucht für ein Zuhause auf Zeit.

Das Bad ist mit einem WC, Waschbecken und einer Dusche ausgestattet.
Die Wohnung wurde charmant eingerichtet und bietet zusätzlich einen Balkon.

Die Lage in Oberschöneweide (Köpenick) spricht für sich - ein sehr sympathischer und authentischer Kiez, wenige Straßenzüge von der Spree entfernt.

Mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln unweit der S-Bahn S8, S9, S45, S46 Schöneweide  in sehr guter, zentraler Lage.

In der Nähe befinden sich viele Grünanlagen und Parks. Einkäufe lassen sich hervorragend bei lokalen Supermärkten und Wochenendmärkten erledigen.

Ebenso befinden sich Kioske oder Baumärkte in nur wenigen Minuten erreichbar.

Die Wohngegend bietet viele gemütliche Bars und Cafès in berlinerischer Atmosphäre. Im Sommer bieten sich außerdem viele Gelegenheiten zum Spazieren in den umliegenden Grünflächen sowie entlang des Wassers an der Spree.

Tram lines 27, 60, 61 67 and the nightbus N65 stop, is just a few metres from the building complex.

The room has approx. 11.3m2

This is a 4 room flat with a shared kitchen and shared bathroom.

This room in the 4-person shared flat also has a communal kitchen with a large dining table. Personal rooms can be locked as per convenience.

The immediate proximity to the campus for the University of Applied Sciences (HTW). The river Spree with its promenade is about 400m away from the Student apartment. A fitness studio is also located in the immediate vicinity.

title: Pohlestraße, Berlin
description:
This freshly renovated and furnished 2-room flat at Pohlestr. 15 in Köpenick offers a radiant, modern interior and high-quality furnishings for a particularly cosy living experience.
Kitchen / living area:
The open-plan living area is characterised by modern furnishings and a dining area. The chic fitted kitchen completes the cosy ambience of the flat. The attractive floor gives the rooms a special atmosphere. A washing machine with tumble dryer function is also integrated in the kitchenette.
Directly from the kitchen you look out into the quiet garden. The terrace there can also be used by all tenants.
Bedroom:
The flat has 2 spacious bedrooms with high-quality box-spring beds, 2 wardrobes and 2 desks and a separate sofa, which can also be used for sleeping.
Bathroom:
The large bathroom impresses with a bathtub, new fittings and extra storage space.


Storage room:
The flat also has a separate storage room where you can store suitcases, shoes and also an iron, ironing board and other items.


Public transport:

Raoul-Wallenberg-Straße S-Bahn station: approx. 10 minutes' walk away.
Salvador-Allende-Straße bus station: Approx. 5 minutes' walk away.
Restaurants:

Restaurant "Zum Hirsch": About 5 minutes' walk away.
Restaurant "Am Wasserfall": Approx. 10 minutes' walk away.
Parks:

Kienbergpark (Gardens of the World): Right next door, less than a 5-minute walk.
Wuhletal hiking trail: About 5 minutes' walk away.
Pharmacies:

"City-Apotheke" pharmacy: about 7 minutes' walk away.
Pharmacy "Apotheke an der Wuhlheide": About 15 minutes' walk away.
Supermarkets:

Edeka Centre: About 5 minutes' walk away.
Lidl: Approx. 10 minutes' walk away.

we charge a fee of 50-100€ per pet per month and the final cleaning is increased by 100€

title: Pohlestraße, Berlin
description:
"Diese frisch sanierte und hochwertig möblierte 4-Zimmer-Wohnung in Berlin Köpenick bietet ein strahlendes, modernes Interieur und eine hochwertige Ausstattung für ein besonders gemütliches Wohnerlebnis. 

Die Wohnung wurde durch einen professionellen Einrichtigungsservice designed und ausgestattet, so dass ein Höchstmaß an Wohnkomfort besteht.

Schlafzimmer:
Die Wohnung verfügt insgesamt über 3x separate, gemütliche Schlafzimmer. Diese sind jeweils mit hochwertigen Boxspringbetten, Kleiderschränken teilweise Schreibtischen ausgestattet sind (siehe Fotos). Teilweise können die Betten auseinander  

Küche / Wohnbereich: 
Die hochwertige und vollständig ausgestatte neue Design Einbauküche lädt zum Kochen und Verweilen ein. Die Küche ist mit einem Kühlschrank, Geschirrspüler, Backofen, Herd ausgestattet und beinhaltet alle notwendigen Küchenutensilien.
Der offene Wohnbereich zeichnet sich durch eine moderne Ausstattung und einen Essbereich mit bequemen Stühlen aus. Zusätzlich ist eine bequemes Sofa vorhanden, das auch als Schafsofa genutzt werden kann. 

Badezimmer:
Es gibt ein modernes Badezimmer, welches über eine bodengleiche Dusche, ein Waschbecken und ein WC verfügt.

Abstellkammer:
Die Wohnung verfügt zudem noch über eine separate Abstellkammer, wo Sie Koffer, Schuhe und auch Bügeleisen, Bügelbrett und Sonstiges verstauen können.

Sonstige Ausstattung:
Moderner Smart TV mit Netflix und Amazon Prime Video Funktionalität
Sonos Soundbox
Internet Flat mit WLAN-Funktion
Reinigungsequipment
Waschmaschine mit Trocknerfunktion in der Wohnung
u.v.m.

Umsatzsteuer:
Bei Anmietungen von weniger als 6 Monaten Dauer, wird zusätzlich zum Mietpreis eine die Umsatzsteuer i.H.v. 7% erhoben.

Haustiere:
Haustiere sind nach Absprache erlaubt. Eine zusätzliche monatliche Gebühr wird erhoben.

Supermärkte:

Lidl: Auf der Köpenicker Landstraße 186, etwa 10 Gehminuten von der Pohlestraße entfernt, befindet sich dieser gut sortierte Discounter mit preiswerten Produkten des täglichen Bedarfs.

About Berlin 

Step into Berlin – a pulsating city steeped in history, teeming with creativity, and offering a universe of possibilities. Nestled at the heart of Europe, Berlin extends an irresistible blend of dynamic culture, architectural wonders, and narratives waiting to be unveiled. As you contemplate your upcoming residence in this thriving metropolis, allow us to offer you a tantalizing glimpse into life in Berlin.
Explore a metropolis where antiquity and modernity coalesce seamlessly. From the iconic Brandenburg Gate to the avant-garde structures of Potsdamer Platz, Berlin's architecture narrates tales of its diverse past and the ongoing evolution of its present. Meander through the picturesque cobblestone pathways of Mitte, where galleries, boutiques, and cafés beckon you to immerse yourself in the city's artistic heartbeat.

Berlin's reputation as a cultural haven precedes it. Encompassing world-class museums and galleries like the Pergamon Museum and the East Side Gallery, the city ardently preserves its historical legacy while exulting in its innovative spirit. The medley of culinary delights – from traditional German sausages to pioneering vegan indulgences – mirrors Berlin's ethos of open-mindedness and inclusivity.

Navigating the city is a breeze, thanks to its impeccable connectivity. The efficient public transportation network facilitates exploration of every nook, from the historical allure of Charlottenburg to the edgy charisma of Friedrichshain. Enjoy a leisurely bike ride along the tranquil Spree River or effortlessly traverse neighborhoods via the U-Bahn.

The heart and soul of Berlin resides in its people. The locals, renowned for their warmth and hospitality, welcome newcomers with arms wide open. Engage in spirited dialogues at local beer gardens, partake in community galas within sprawling parks like Tiergarten, and submerge yourself in the city's vibrant nightlife – ranging from intimate jazz enclaves to throbbing techno sanctuaries.

Berlin's allure extends to history buffs, culture aficionados, and seekers of a vibrant lifestyle alike. As you contemplate embracing this city as your own, envisage your role within its narrative – a narrative that champions diversity, innovation, and an unceasing spirit of renaissance. Your voyage in Berlin is on the brink of commencement, and your fresh odyssey promises to be nothing short of extraordinary.

title: Griechische Allee, Berlin
description:
Arrive, unpack, and feel at home from day one: This stylishly furnished 1-bedroom top-floor apartment in a well-maintained historic building combines classic architectural charm with modern living comfort. Fully modernized in 2022, the apartment offers approx. [61 sqm] of thoughtfully designed living space for anyone looking for high-quality, hassle-free living in Berlin.  

Large windows, bright interiors, and the sunny south-facing terrace create a calm and welcoming atmosphere above the rooftops of Berlin-Oberschöneweide. At the same time, you benefit from excellent public transport connections and short distances to supermarkets, cafés, universities, and BER airport.  

Whether you are a commuter, expat, student, researcher, or business professional: thanks to the complete furnishing, high-speed internet, and fully equipped setup, the apartment is ideal for comfortable temporary living with zero stress and maximum convenience.

Additional Information

The apartment comes fully furnished and is ready for immediate move-in.  

Apartment Highlights  
* South-facing sun terrace with open views 
* Bright living and dining area with sofa lounge 
* Separate bedroom with bed [160 x 200 cm] 
* Dedicated workspace / home office area 
* Modern fitted kitchen including: 
* induction cooktop 
* dishwasher 
* refrigerator 
* complete kitchen equipment 
* Modernized bathroom featuring: 
* walk-in rain shower 
* LED mirror 
* washing machine 
* Large built-in hallway wardrobe with generous storage space 
* Blackout options in the bedroom 
* High-speed Wi-Fi included 
* Bicycle parking in the green courtyard 

Location & Surroundings  

The apartment is located in [Berlin-Oberschöneweide | Treptow-Köpenick] on a quiet side street between the River Spree and Wuhlheide Park. 
 
Especially attractive for students, expats, and business commuters:  
* HTW Berlin approx. 4 minutes by bike 
* Catalyst Institute easily reachable 
* Several supermarkets (REWE, EDEKA, Lidl, ALDI) within less than 5 minutes walking distance 
* Cafés, bakeries, pharmacies, and restaurants nearby 
* River Spree with running and cycling paths only approx. 500 m away 
* Wuhlheide Park and FEZ leisure center quickly accessible  

Public Transport Connections  
* Tram lines M17, 21, 27, 37, 60, and 67 within approx. 4 minutes walking distance 
* S-Schöneweide station reachable within minutes 
* BER Airport approx. 20 minutes away 
* Alexanderplatz approx. 25 minutes by public transport  

The location combines peaceful green surroundings with fast access to Berlin’s city center.

title: Köpenicker Straße, Berlin
description:
Apartment:
Large Co-Living flat in Alt-Glienicke/Adlershof. 100sqm,  2nd floor, 4 bedrooms. Spacious kitchen and living area with new and fully equipped kitchen (fridge, freezer, stove, oven, sink, dishwasher, storage, table, chairs, vacuum cleaner). Large bathroom with large sink, shower and bathtub. 4 bedrooms to be rented separately or all together (vary from 12-23sqm per room). All furnished and lockable rooms. 

Location:
Close proximity to the following universities: HU Adlershof, BBW University of Applied Sciences, HTW. The bus station (line 260, 160, N60) is right in front of the apartment. Other bus stops very close by, and the next big S-Bahn stations are Adlershof & Altglienicke. BER Airport not far either. 

Shopping: 
REWE, Netto, Aldi, Lidl, dm, Pharmacy very close by foot 

Anmeldung possible.

Wilhelminenhofstraße 31, 12459 Berlin is located in the Oberschöneweide neighborhood in the southeastern part of Berlin. This area, part of the Treptow-Köpenick district, is known for its industrial history and is increasingly becoming a residential and commercial hub. Here’s an overview of the transport connectivity and nearby supermarkets for this location:

Transport Connectivity
Tram:

Tram Lines (M17, 21, 27, 67): The nearest tram stop is directly on Wilhelminenhofstraße, just a 1-2 minute walk from Wilhelminenhofstraße 31. The M17, 21, 27, and 67 tram lines provide connections to various parts of Berlin. These trams connect Oberschöneweide to major hubs like Treptower Park, Schöneweide S-Bahn station, and other parts of the city.
S-Bahn (Urban Rail):

S-Bahn Station (Schöneweide): The closest S-Bahn station is Schöneweide, about a 15-minute walk or a short tram ride away. This station is served by the S8, S9, and S45 lines, offering connections to central Berlin, including Alexanderplatz and Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER). The S9 line is particularly useful as it connects directly to the airport.
Bus Services:

Bus Lines: Several bus lines operate in the area, including the 165 and 265 buses. These buses connect Oberschöneweide to neighboring districts and provide an alternative to the tram for reaching Schöneweide S-Bahn station or further into the city.
Car/Bike:

The area is accessible by car, with major roads nearby. Parking is relatively easier compared to more central areas of Berlin. Oberschöneweide is also bike-friendly, with bike lanes and paths along the Spree River, making it convenient for cyclists.
Nearby Supermarkets
Netto Marken-Discount: Located about a 5-minute walk away at Wilhelminenhofstraße 87, Netto offers a variety of budget-friendly groceries and household items.

Aldi Nord: Situated around a 10-minute walk at Edisonstraße 64, Aldi Nord provides low-priced groceries and essentials.

PENNY: A budget-friendly alternative, PENNY is located about a 12-minute walk away at Siemensstraße 16-18, offering a variety of groceries at low prices.

Wilhelminenhofstraße 31 has good transport connectivity, with tram lines just steps away and access to the S-Bahn for longer commutes. The area is well-served by several supermarkets within walking distance, providing a range of options for everyday shopping needs.

title: Herrenhausstraße, Berlin
description:
Large, bright, modern, newly and comfortably furnished flat with 2 rooms in Berlin-Johannisthal/Adlershof. Minimum rental period 3 months!

Fitted kitchen, bathroom (shower and bathtub), large balcony. Completely renovated and newly furnished. Magnificent view over Berlin to the TV tower. 
The flat is located in the green district Treptow-Köpenick of Berlin, in the district Johannisthal, close to Berlin-Adlershof.

Bright and cosy living room, comfortable double bed couch for 2 persons, modern 80 cm LED TV, ste(hidden)ystem. Internet access, wifi.

The bedroom has a large double bed and a wardrobe, as well as a chest of drawers and an armchair. In the living room there is a comfortable sofa bed (lying surface 1.40 m x 2.00 m). 

Large fully equipped kitchen with window, dining area with bench and 3 chairs in rustic style. Cooker with 4 ceramic hobs, oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, freezer, kettle, toaster, coffee maker, dishes. 

Hallway, kitchen and bathroom are tiled. The other rooms have laminated or carpet flooring. 

The bathroom has a bathtub and a shower, WC, washing machine and a modern sink, mirror, towel radiator. 

No hotel-like services such as bed linen change, towel or cleaning service.

The view from the 12 m2 balcony leads over all surrounding houses to the west up to the TV tower. Sun from about 2pm on the balcony until sunset over Berlin. From all windows you have a wide view into the green and over the roofs.

The flat is on the 6th floor. A modern lift is available.

No traffic noise as the street is a cul-de-sac, used only by residents. 

Conveniently located. Adlershof, Schönefeld, Köpenick, Treptow, Rudow, Neukölln are easily accessible.

In the immediate vicinity (up to a maximum of 10 minutes walk) are 5 supermarkets and many restaurants, a cinema, a post office. The Schöneweide centre (1.6 km away) and Europe's largest shopping centre the "Gropiuspassagen" (4.9 km) invite you to shop and linger.

Berlin's city centre can be reached in 20 minutes via the city motorway or by S-Bahn from Berlin-Schöneweide station. Messe Berlin is 17 minutes away via the city motorway. Berlin Schönefeld Airport is 10 minutes away. The media centre Berlin-Adlershof is 5 minutes away. Bus and tram stops are in the immediate vicinity of the flat.

Arrival via the A113 motorway, exit "Stubenrauchstrasse".

It is a mature residential area with predominantly flat buildings. Quiet location in the south-east of Berlin in the green district of Treptow-Köpenick.

The many lakes and forests in the surrounding area invite you to relax. The "Königsheide" - a large piece of forest of 4 km x 1 km is in the immediate vicinity. The Müggelsee is easy to reach and invites you to swim and do water sports.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore, exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message, and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!

Single-Flat with private river view. Living face to face with the water is a unique and life changing experience. Go for a swim before going to work, go fishing whenever you like, just watch the nature or even get your own boat and park it in front of your doorstep. Yet you are in BERLIN. KÖPENICK
Köpenick, the idyllic suburb in the south-east of Berlin, is a real insider tip for anyone who wants to experience the best of both worlds: the pulsating energy of the capital and the tranquil beauty of nature. Nestled between the Großer Müggelsee lake and the Dahme river (where the flat is located), Köpenick offers an impressive mix of historical sights, green oases and modern comforts. Köpenick is also a safe place to live, as Köpenick is the place in Berlin with the lowest crime rate.

You will immediately be enchanted by the picturesque old town of Köpenick, with its charming cobbled streets, well-preserved half-timbered houses and the impressive Köpenick Palace. This baroque palace, surrounded by a magnificent park, now houses a branch of the Museum of Decorative Arts and offers a fascinating insight into the history and culture of the region.

Köpenick is a paradise for nature lovers. The extensive forests, lakes and rivers invite you to enjoy a wide range of leisure activities. Whether sailing, hiking, cycling, inline skating, swimming, rowing or simply taking a relaxing stroll along the lakeside promenade - here everyone will find the perfect opportunity to escape from everyday life and recharge their batteries.

Despite its tranquil atmosphere, Köpenick has excellent connections to the centre of Berlin. You can reach the capital's famous sights, such as the Brandenburg Gate, Alexanderplatz or Museum Island, in no time at all by S-Bahn or car. After an exciting day in the city, you can return to the peace and comfort of your flat in Köpenick.

From the flat you can quickly reach the airport or the city centre:

BER airport
- 20 minutes by car, taxi, Uber
- 45 minutes by bus or S-Bahn

- 10 minutes by car or bike
- 20 minutes by bus or tram

Köpenick old town

Lidl, supermarket
- 1 minute by bike
- 4 minutes on foot

Culinary delights are not neglected in Köpenick either. A variety of restaurants, cafés and beer gardens offer delicacies from all over the world, often with a distinctive regional touch. Try fresh fish from the surrounding waters or enjoy a hearty German beer in one of the traditional pubs.

Köpenick is more than just a suburb - it's a way of life. A place where history meets modernity, nature meets urbanity and tranquillity meets vibrancy. A place that offers both families and individuals an unrivalled quality of life. Let yourself be enchanted by Köpenick and experience Berlin at its best. Welcome to your new home!
